patterns.self_hosted_mac: Never use actions/setup-python on self-hosted Mac. Always use venv.
patterns.timeouts: Never set step timeout higher than job timeout. Always add unbuffered output.
patterns.cookies: Google OAuth cannot be automated. Use email+password accounts for full automation.
patterns.captcha_services: Always auto-disable paid services after first balance error. Never retry 40 times.
patterns.file_paths: Always verify scripts referenced in workflows are actually committed to git.
patterns.chrome_selenium: ANY workflow using Selenium/Chrome/undetected-chromedriver MUST include webdriver-manager + ChromeDriverManager().install()
patterns.google_oauth: Google OAuth (Sign in with Google) CANNOT be automated. Requires one-time human click. Use email+password accounts for full automation.
patterns.runner_restart: After git push with workflow/code fixes, runner laptop MUST: git pull && ./svc.sh stop && ./svc.sh start. Old code stays cached until restart.
patterns.indeed_cookies: Indeed uses Google OAuth. Cannot auto-login. Must run scripts/indeed_auto_login.py ONCE per laptop.
patterns.cookie_types: Chrome SQLite stores booleans as int (0/1). ALWAYS convert to Python bool before Playwright/Selenium add_cookies().
patterns.dice_runner: Dice MUST run on ubuntu-latest. Self-hosted Mac headless Chrome gets silently rejected by Dice anti-bot.
patterns.dice_dedup: Dice does NOT prevent re-application at UI level — silently ignores. Script MUST check for Already Applied badge.

rules_for_new_workflows: Use venv (python3 -m venv) — never bare pip install
Add webdriver-manager for any Selenium/Chrome workflow
Set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 for real-time CI output
Add timeout-minutes to both job level AND long-running steps
Exit with code 1 on actual failure (not silent success)
Save failures to agent/data/failed_jobs.json for retry
